name: Solon's democratic compromise
plain_explanation: Early in the sixth century, the lawgiver Solon eased aristocratic oppression of farmers and artisans with a partial move toward democracy, laying groundwork later built on under Pericles.
precise_definition: A constitutional compromise, made early in the sixth century B.C., that mitigated the aristocracy's control of a government that had oppressed both country farmers (burdened by debt from the shift to cash-crop farming) and urban artisans.

evolution.treatment: Early in the sixth century, the lawgiver Solon eased aristocratic oppression of farmers and artisans with a partial move toward democracy, laying groundwork later built on under Pericles.
